description: Defines the ElementsUploadDataStream class, a non-chunked upload data stream composed of multiple upload elements, including methods for initialization, reading, and resetting the stream.

classes.name: ElementsUploadDataStream
classes.description: A class representing a non-chunked upload data stream composed of multiple upload elements, supporting initialization, reading, and reset operations.

methods.name: ElementsUploadDataStream
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the stream with a vector of upload element readers and an identifier.

methods.name: CreateWithReader
methods.description: Static method to create an ElementsUploadDataStream with a single upload element reader.

methods.name: IsInMemory
methods.description: Checks if the data stream is in memory.

methods.name: GetElementReaders
methods.description: Returns the list of upload element readers.

methods.name: InitInternal
methods.description: Initializes the data stream internally, given a net log source.

methods.name: ReadInternal
methods.description: Reads data into a buffer from the stream.

methods.name: ResetInternal
methods.description: Resets the stream to its initial state.

methods.name: InitElements
methods.description: Runs initialization for all element readers starting from a specific index.

methods.name: OnInitElementCompleted
methods.description: Callback when an element finishes initialization; proceeds to next or completes.

methods.name: ReadElements
methods.description: Reads data from the current element readers into a buffer.

methods.name: OnReadElementCompleted
methods.description: Callback when a read operation on an element completes.

methods.name: ProcessReadResult
methods.description: Processes the result of a read operation, updating buffer offset or handling errors.
